fabc10bc59 ci: Update binfmt qemu note

Modern container engines ship QEMU by default. So installing
qemu-user-static is not always needed.

Also, docker.io/multiarch/qemu-user-static hasn't been updated in years
and the replacement according to the Docker docs is tonistiigi/binfmt.

fa5de5cd16 ci: Reword readme

* Clarify ./depends as ../depends
* Remove note that scripts are ordered. They are not:
  02_run_container.py runs before 01_base_install.sh and some scripts
  have no number: GetCMakeLogFiles.cmake, wrap-valgrind.py, ...
* Clarify that the CI cache also covers container images and ccache.
